subject: Customer kickoff — regional slotting, attendee roster & host ownership
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aishap@foliohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer kickoff — regional slotting, attendee roster & host ownership

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood. We want to lock the week-zero kickoff so your teams can get access and we can validate SSO, data flows, and basic model behavior before we move into Sprint 1.

Proposed 90-minute window options (all PT):
  • Option A: Tue Jun 24, 10:00–11:30 PT
  • Option B: Wed Jun 25, 13:00–14:30 PT (late option for EMEA overlap)
  • Option C: Thu Jun 26, 08:30–10:00 PT (early US West friendly)

Must-have attendees from your side:
  - Primary technical lead (SSO/roles)
  - Data/infra contact (for network & VPC checks)
  - Product owner (to confirm acceptance criteria and success metrics)

From our side I propose:
  - Karthik Iyer — overall kickoff owner / agenda lead
  - Ben Carter — implementation tech lead (SSO, infra, KV access)
  - Laura Bennett — onboarding ops (runbook, scheduling)
  - Neha Kapoor — customer success (post-launch cadence)

Attached: SOW_v1.pdf (current), kickoff-agenda-v0.3.docx (draft).
Bridge: I'll provide a primary Zoom and a fallback link once we confirm slot.

Ask: Please confirm which option works (A/B/C) and the full names + emails for the internal attendees you plan to include. If procurement needs to loop in anyone for contracts, mention them and we’ll route a separate thread.

Thanks — looking forward.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Aisha Patel <aishap@foliohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@foliohealth.com>, procurement@foliohealth.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer kickoff — regional slotting, attendee roster & host ownership

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear options. Option B (Wed Jun 25, 13:00–14:30 PT) works best for our cross-regional team.

Attendees from Folio Health (confirmed for the moment):
  - Aisha Patel (Platform/Product Lead) — aishap@foliohealth.com
  - Tom Rivera (Infra Lead) — tom.rivera@foliohealth.com
  - Priya Shah (PM) — priya.shah@foliohealth.com (TBC)
  - procurement@foliohealth.com (please include for contract questions)

We’ll need a brief pre-kickoff checklist focused on: SSO test users, IP allowlist entries (for your bridge & any monitoring), and a sandbox data load plan. Can you add those to the agenda?

Also, FYI — procurement may ask for an updated SOW and limited warranty language; I’ve CCed them so they can start reviewing.

On the bridge: please send the link and an .ics invite after you confirm with your host owners.

Thanks,
Aisha

Karthik/Team —

Option B looks good on our side as well. I’ll own the primary host duties for the kickoff and will set up the Zoom bridge + record settings. Ben — can you take the SSO validation portion? Laura — can you prepare the runbook doc we’ll use live (I’ll attach the .ics and the bridge once I create them).

Quick checklist I’ll include in the invite:
  1) SSO test user (1 account) available and credentials in a secure note
  2) Network allowlist entries for Zoom + Redwood telemetry IPs (I’ll paste ranges in the invite)
  3) Sample payload & sandbox dataset access (s3 presigned or small CSV)
  4) Acceptance criteria overview and next steps (owner+ETA)

Attaching: bridge-invite.ics (will push calendar after confirmation).
